_comment: One binding = one QNN graphExecute = a contiguous run of IR dispatch ids. mlp_control is 7 IR ops (4 linear + 3 elu) and ~70k MACs, so the whole net is one tile: any finer split pays a second dispatch (~0.5 ms of FastRPC on dsp) to save microseconds of compute.
_correctness_note: The CPU tile is fp32 on purpose. The QNN CPU backend's int8 path is BROKEN for this network: with mlp_control_quantized.dlc, three genuinely different inputs produce byte-identical outputs, while the same DLC on the DSP produces three different ones. Verified with qnn-net-run on 2026-08-30 (same input list, backend the only variable). The int8 CPU context is 28.5 us and wrong; the fp32 context is 107.3 us and right.
